That native candidate was not present in any recovered branch. Recreate its composition from the screenshot; do not claim recovery of its original pixels.
equipment: Two identical modest faceted/octagonal dumbbells from fixed reusable near/far projections; one fixed flat bench; front trainer flat on floor; rear instep laces-down on bench.
camera: Fixed left-facing side/three-quarter view, black landscape canvas, full body, both dumbbell grips visible.

muscleHierarchy.primary: Working front-leg quadriceps in the strongest purple.
muscleHierarchy.secondary: Working front-leg glute and hamstrings in lighter lilac where anatomically visible.
muscleHierarchy.stabilisers: Core only a subtle pale tint if useful; supporting rear thigh remains neutral light grey.
muscleHierarchy.meaning: Qualitative roles, not a measured activation heat map. Keep the hierarchy unchanged through the repetition.

fixedAnchors: Bench silhouette and both bench floor contacts
Front shoe heel and toe floor contacts
Rear shoe laces/instep contact on bench
rigidInvariants: Dumbbell head size and handle length

beats.name: SET UP
beats.cue: Plant front foot; rest your rear instep.
beats.state: Tall braced torso, soft front knee, arms hanging with dumbbells.

beats.name: BEGIN LOWERING
beats.cue: Bend your front knee; lower with control.
beats.state: Pelvis approximately one third from setup toward bottom; knee tracks over front foot; supports fixed.

beats.name: LOWER FURTHER
beats.cue: Keep your front heel planted while descending.
beats.state: Pelvis approximately two thirds from setup toward bottom; torso braced; supports fixed.

beats.name: REACH DEPTH
beats.cue: Reach comfortable depth without bouncing or shifting.
beats.state: Front thigh approaches horizontal; back knee lowers toward floor; neither foot shifts.

beats.name: DRIVE UP
beats.cue: Drive through your front foot; rise steadily.
beats.state: Return through the same two-thirds-depth configuration with both grips intact.

beats.name: CONTINUE RISING
beats.cue: Continue rising; keep feet and grips fixed.
beats.state: Return through the one-third-depth configuration; the 6-to-1 transition completes standing before the next repetition.
